templates.name: Go Discord bot
templates.summary: A DiscordGo starter with guild-scoped slash commands.
templates.description: A Discord Gateway bot with /ping and /about slash commands. Commands are registered in one development server for fast iteration, with minimal gateway intents and a graceful connection shutdown.

env.description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal.
ID of the development server where commands are registered.

templates.name: Go HTTP API
templates.summary: A small JSON API using the Go standard library.
templates.description: An HTTP API with a health endpoint, a validated greeting endpoint, request timeouts, and graceful shutdown. A small foundation for your own backend with no framework dependency.

templates.name: Go Telegram bot
templates.summary: A gotgbot starter with /start, /help, and /ping commands.
templates.description: A long-polling Telegram bot built with gotgbot. No public endpoint is needed. Includes graceful shutdown, explicit token configuration, and examples of command handling.

env.description: Create a bot with Telegram BotFather and paste its API token.

templates.name: Next.js portfolio
templates.summary: A personal site with project stories and a writing section.
templates.description: A single-page editorial portfolio with a project grid, expandable case studies, an about section, and writing notes. Edit a single content file to make it yours. Exported as static HTML for a small, predictable runtime.

templates.name: Next.js website
templates.summary: A complete product website with a server-rendered contact page.
templates.description: A product website for a small software company: a home page, feature and workflow sections, and a contact page. Runs the Next.js App Router as a standalone Node server, with a configurable email contact link and explicit writable cache handling.

env.description: Public contact email displayed by the website. Does not configure outbound email.

templates.name: Express API
templates.summary: An Express 5 backend with validation and health checks.
templates.description: A small Node.js API with a health endpoint, bounded JSON request bodies, explicit validation, graceful shutdown, and automated HTTP tests.

templates.name: FastAPI API
templates.summary: A typed Python API with automatic OpenAPI documentation.
templates.description: A FastAPI service with a health check, validated request models, OpenAPI documentation, and tests. The container runs a single Uvicorn process with a non-root user.

templates.name: Static personal website
templates.description: A one-page personal website made with HTML and CSS. Customize the introduction, selected work, and contact links. Served by an unprivileged Nginx container with runtime files in /tmp.
